summary: Every mail takes you straight to the right page, drift shows exactly what differs, and you can ignore a finding with a reason.

new.title: Every mail opens the right page
new.text: Every PIM Manager mail now has an "Open in PIM Manager" button that opens the page it is about. Mails that carry a sign-in credential have no link.

new.title: Drift shows what differs
new.text: A changed drift finding now shows the field with its current and desired value. The drift alert mail lists the findings themselves, not only counts.

new.title: Ignore a drift finding
new.text: An Admin can ignore a drift finding with a reason. It leaves the counts, the page and the mail, and ignored findings are listed separately and can be un-ignored.

fixes.title: Review now works in reminders
fixes.text: The "Review now" button in the review reminder mail now works.
